name: Can I remove mold around windows myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove mold around windows myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, surface-level mold spots (less than 10 square feet) caused by condensation, you might be able to clean it yourself with appropriate safety gear and cleaning solutions. However, if the mold covers a larger area, reoccurs, has a strong musty odor, or if you suspect it’s growing behind walls or due to a leak, it's best to hire a professional. Professionals ensure complete removal, address the source, and prevent future growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can clean small surface mold yourself, but for larger areas, recurring issues, or suspected hidden growth, hire a professional for complete removal and source remediation.
